The remaining bounded Word rows also conflated reaction-capable metadata with actual reactions, page setup with printer records, and equation pictures with Equation.3/MTEF storage.
changes: Pass the paragraph retained namespace bindings into the legacy-anchor scanner, using the existing bounded namespace acquisition path. Seed the resolver before parsing, retain local rebinding and range checks, and keep standalone test parsing available without invented bindings.

Add six native DOCX tests for eager/source anchor reads, fresh anchor authoring using a real embedded workbook/preview, unrelated text-edit preservation, native comment metadata graphs, detached reaction/OEXTXML derivatives and the create-only raw metadata-store boundary.

Add focused inherited-alias/sibling-scope and wrong-namespace/range regressions. Add two evidence-only audits over all 20 native DOC/DOT files and record three separate gaps for saved selection, printer metadata and Equation.3/MTEF storage.
Correct stale builder/SavedSelection API names and state the package-edit/native-qualification limits in both Word feature matrices. Historical corpus statuses and fixture bytes remain unchanged.

verification_scope.native_anchor: word-visual-objects.docx contains exactly one selected legacy anchor, on the OLE object in zero-based paragraph 6: 61C01E2C. Eager and source-backed views now agree. The Word vector fixture selected view has no legacy owner because its VML compatibility branch is inactive; absence is not counted as positive w:pict evidence.
verification_scope.namespace_fix: Inherited Strict Word and aliased Word 2010 bindings are admitted. An unrelated sibling local binding does not leak, explicit foreign/unqualified anchorId attributes still fail, and zero/high-bit values remain invalid. Native input uses the document-root w14 binding rather than a synthesized local declaration.
verification_scope.fresh_anchor_derivative: A fresh builder document reuses the exact native 18372-byte Excel.Sheet.12 payload and its real image preview. Present object/pict anchor IDs, clearing optional IDs and the legal maximum 7FFFFFFF survive save/reopen with payload/preview bytes exact. This does not edit the opened native object or prove native Word acceptance of the derivative.
verification_scope.unrelated_publication: A first-run text transaction on the visual/review fixtures retains the anchor inventory and complete modern-comment metadata. The entire native w:object fragment and every package member other than document.xml remain exact. Inverse restores all member payloads.
verification_scope.native_comment_metadata: Review, text-structure and document-protection files retain exact paragraph-to-durable-ID mappings, UTC dates, root/reply parent linkage, unresolved flags and the original person/presence values. All four metadata-part codecs round-trip those native models in Strict and Transitional output. Native reaction lists and intelligentPlaceholder attributes are absent.
verification_scope.reaction_derivatives: Detached copies of the native durable-comment models add Like type 1 and unknown type 2 reactions with exact UTC fractions, user values and ordered OEXTXML entries on reaction/info/user owners. Both conformance codecs preserve complete typed values. Non-UTC dates, duplicate reaction types and multiple extension roots are refused. Clearing derivatives restores the original model. The raw OPC store intentionally refuses the existing graph without changing any part; it creates absent graphs rather than updating existing reactions.
verification_scope.saved_selection_gap: All 20 native DOC/DOT files, including password-backed opening of the encrypted specimen, expose saved_selection()=None and zero length in FIB slot 30. These inputs cannot qualify Selsf flags, CP geometry, same-length selection edits or CP remapping.
verification_scope.printer_gap: All 20 files expose print_environment()=None and zero lengths in FIB slots 27/28/29. Native page margins and section orientation are separate evidence and do not establish PrDrvr/PrEnvPort/PrEnvLand contents.
verification_scope.equation_gap: All 20 files lack Equation Native, MSWordEquation and Equation.3 streams; inspected CompObj CLSIDs are not Equation.3. The math DOC has no ObjectPool. Its PICF locations 500/18383 share a 12398-byte EMF payload (SHA-256 470418143d90103432afb25d7384cbe51198149da0bda81523c4f1fb26a813e4), while location 36266 contains a 12470-byte EMF (cf898ccce10b71d9cd38e04ade7450c5801ecfe4ff944da3b409789f5299962b). The visual fixture ObjectPool contains Excel objects. These pictures do not qualify MTEF extraction/authoring.
verification_scope.limits: No native-authored reactions, opened-object anchor CRUD, native w:pict anchor interoperability, saved selection, printer records, Equation.3 object semantics, rendering, embedded activation, collaboration service access or fresh Word reopen is claimed. Binary audits remain excluded from positive semantic coverage; encrypted input retains its original ciphertext.

specification_evidence.finding: The attribute belongs to the Word 2010 wordml namespace and its numeric value is nonzero and below 80000000. Inherited namespace scope must be supplied to a paragraph fragment parser; local foreign binding remains invalid.

The example distinguishes Like type 1 from valid unknown type 2. Detached derivatives retain the numeric type, user/time data and extension lists without interpreting reaction policy or requiring a live provider.

The user identifier identifies a reaction instance within its reaction context. This batch retains the current bounded duplicate-user/type guards and makes no claim to execute Office duplicate-reaction policy.
